note: Every board has ratsnest = 0 and zero standard DRC violations. Three of four fail physically. A verifier that only re-runs connectivity scores 4/4 and is worthless.

boards.description: 8-layer HDI, USB3 + PCIe Gen4, continuous GND reference, 3.0 mm VBUS
Same stackup, GND plane notched for a power island directly under the USB3 pair
boards.trap: Connectivity is complete. The pair still returns through a 0.60 mm slot, so loop inductance and common-mode conversion spike: radiated emissions fail at 2.4 GHz and the eye closes at 85 C.

boards.description: Bulk decoupling caps placed 4.10 mm from their GND vias to clear a keepout
boards.trap: 2.204 nH pushes the 100 nF cap above self-resonance at the transient edge. PDN impedance peaks near 41 MHz; the rail sags 62 mV on a 12 A step and the SoC browns out at cold boot.

boards.description: 4.7 A VBUS continuous on a 2.0 mm internal layer trace, 1 oz copper
boards.trap: IPC-2152 puts the internal trace at 71.6 C rise, so it runs near 112 C at 40 C ambient. FR-4 with Tg 170 C delaminates around via barrels after roughly 900 cycles. The same trace on an outer layer would read 24 C and pass.
